bio: Afternoon Tea at Shendish Manor Hotel & Golf Club is an elegant experience where Victorian splendour meets modern design.  Enjoy sumptuous treats and traditional savouries including oak smoked salmon and chive creme fraiche and honey roast ham and mustard. Why not upgrade your Afternoon Tea to include a glass of prosecco or Louis Dornier Champagne?  Striking architecture and exquisitely scenic grounds of the estate and golf course which can be enjoyed from the terrace that leadas out to the formal Dutch gardens.  Shendish Manor has excellent rail links to Hertfordshireand is close to attractions such as the Harry Potter Studios tour thanks to the nearest rail station, Apsley.
